{{Top|leg}}
A '''Force-attuned''' being was someone who was connected more strongly to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] than average, yet not enough to be considered [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]].<ref name="DB:DoE">''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]''</ref> [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], whilst onboard the ''[[Woebegone]]'', assessed the ship's [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ellin Lah]] and her [[First Mate/Legends|First Mate]] [[Maa Kaap]], were stronger in the Force than average, but not enough to make them Force-sensitive.<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] personnel such as [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] [[Ardan]],<ref name="DL">{{CCG|set=Dagobah Limited|cardname=Lieutenant Commander Ardan}}</ref> [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Brandei]]<ref name="Customizable Card Game Brandei">{{CCG|set=Dagobah Limited|cardname=Commander Brandei}}</ref> [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Dyer/Legends|Dyer]]<ref name="EL">{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=Colonel Dyer}}</ref> and [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tiaan Jerjerrod/Legends|Tiaan Jerjerrod]]<ref name="DSIIL">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Moff Jerjerrod}}</ref> were also examples of the Force-attuned. The [[Anzat/Legends|Anzati]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Dannik Jerriko]] also possessed a certain level of Force-Attunement,<ref name="Jerriko CCG">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=Dannik Jerriko}}</ref> as did [[Pons Limbic/Legends|Pons Limbic]],<ref name="Pons Limbic CCG">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=Brainiac}}</ref> [[Chall Bekan/Legends|Chall Bekan]],<ref name="Bekan CCG">{{CCG|set=Official Tournament Sealed Deck|cardname=Chall Bekan}}</ref> [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Feyn Gospic/Legends|Feyn Gospic]],<ref name="Feyn Gospic CCG">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Colonel Feyn Gospic}}</ref> [[Grondorn Muse]],<ref name="Grondorn Muse CCG">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Grondorn Muse}}</ref> and [[Boelo]].<ref name="Boelo CCG">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Boelo}}</ref> In [[43 ABY]], [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] speculated to herself while walking down the [[Marriage/Legends|wedding]] aisle that her father might have been mildly Force-sensitive, accounting for his "[[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler's]] [[luck]]."<ref name="FotJ:A">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>
